_doc: Who this company is. Every tool reads its names, clock and station address from here (company/tools/lib/company.js), so founding a new company is an edit to this file plus the charter, never a code change. scripts/found-company.sh fills it in.
name: Unfounded Company

runtime._doc: runtime.scheduler: who starts the crew's scheduled loop runs. "dispatcher" = the dispatcher, through admit(), with the crew loop routines paused on the station and one watchdog routine there; "station" = the station's own schedule (the old way; absent = station). Switch only with company/tools/budget-migrate.js (docs/BUDGET.md). The framework template leaves it unset (an existing company that pulls an update keeps the station until it migrates); found-company.sh sets "dispatcher" for a new company.

ownerChannel._doc: How the owner and the company talk. 'console' (default) = the owner console: every open question shows on Today the moment it is asked and is answered there; messages travel through company/owner/inbound.jsonl (owner -> company) and company/owner/outbound.jsonl (company -> owner), read and written by company/tools/owner-inbox.js and the dispatcher. 'file' = the same files with no console. A push adapter (a chat app, email) plugs in by delivering outbound.jsonl and appending to inbound.jsonl; set dailyLimit (questions per day) so it does not buzz all day.
